name: Indinavir Sulfate
summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, produced risk scores for Indinavir Sulfate [M]. This computer model rated the drug's liver risk score at 54, placing it in the medium category, while its heart risk score was evaluated at 36, putting it in the low category [M]. There are four total clinical research studies associated with this drug, three of which were located via a trials search [3].
